title: Helm
description: Optional Kubernetes deployment: the umbrella Helm chart, shared `common` library chart, hardened initialization chart, the network-policy/secret/service-account templates, and the `helm-validate` task. Hidden `helm-*` integration capabilities own runtime and database subcharts and activate with their service; the hidden `helm-auth` integration owns the APISIX edge gateway, the OIDC ingress, and the gateway/auth values, so a Helm selection without auth renders no gateway or ingress. Template-only — it publishes no package and is delivered through the Git source.
